scenes.text: Hundreds of dollars for one steak, and it is no scam.
Course three comes from Japan. Real Kobe beef comes only from Hyogo, and every cut is tracked from farm to plate.
It's A5 wagyu, the highest grade of beef on Earth. Inspectors score the marbling, those white ribbons of fat, from one to twelve.
In the pan, the fat melts at a lower temperature than normal beef, so it dissolves on your tongue. Good to know: a few thin slices are enough.
Worth it or overrated? Drop your take below.
